generated.description: A gray, naval destroyer modeled on the US Navy's DDG-51 Arleigh Burke class, built mostly from stone slabs, light gray and gray wool, red terracotta, and quartz. It is about 25 blocks wide, 64 high, and 157 long, with a stepped superstructure, a flat deck, and a sharp bow. The interior is not described, though the build includes signs, dispensers, comparators, and iron doors and trapdoors.
